SELECT inv_mast_comp.item_id 'inv_mast_item_id',
    COALESCE(service_labor.service_labor_desc, inv_mast_comp.item_desc) 'item_desc',
    assembly_line.quantity ,
    assembly_line.delete_flag ,
    inv_mast.item_id ,
    assembly_line.date_created ,
    assembly_line.date_last_modified ,
    assembly_line.last_maintained_by ,
    assembly_line.sub_assembly ,
    assembly_line.taxable ,
    assembly_line.sequence_number ,
    assembly_line.unit_of_measure ,
    assembly_line.other_charge_item ,
    inv_mast_comp.other_charge_item ,
    assembly_line.component_inv_mast_uid ,
    assembly_line.inv_mast_uid,
    assembly_line.component_cut_length,
    assembly_line.cut_length_edited_flag,
    CASE assembly_hdr.hose_assembly_flag
    WHEN 'Y' THEN
    inv_mast_assem_info.component_type
    ELSE
    300
    END component_type,
    CASE assembly_hdr.hose_assembly_flag
    WHEN 'Y' THEN
    inv_mast_assem_info.hose_fitting_d_length
    ELSE
    0
    END hose_fitting_d_length,
    CASE assembly_hdr.hose_assembly_flag
    WHEN 'Y' THEN
    inv_mast_assem_info.hose_fitting_uom
    ELSE
    ' '
    END hose_fitting_uom,
    assembly_line.qty_needed,
    COALESCE(operation.type, 1578) operation_type_cd,
    service_labor.service_labor_id,
    service_labor.service_labor_desc,
    assembly_line.service_labor_uid,
    assembly_line.operation_uid,
    operation.operation_cd,
    assembly_line.date_offset_days,
    assembly_hdr.production_order_processing
    ,COALESCE(drv_subassembly_hdr.production_order_processing, 'N') 'sub_assembly_prod_order_flag'
    ,item_revision.revision_level
    ,COALESCE(inv_mast_comp.use_revisions_flag, 'N') use_revisions_flag
    ,component_item_revision_uid
    ,assembly_item_revision_uid
    ,assembly_line.backflush_flag
    ,  ' ' viewed_line_note
    ,assembly_line.assembly_line_uid
    ,assembly_line.extended_desc
    ,inv_mast_comp.tally_flag
    ,'N' 'tally_info_specified'
    ,assembly_line.loose_ship_flag
    ,COALESCE(service_labor.service_labor_id, inv_mast_comp.item_id) 'item_id_service_labor_id'
    ,assembly_line.operation_sequence
    ,CASE WHEN service_labor.service_labor_uid IS NOT NULL THEN service_labor.service_labor_ext_desc ELSE inv_mast_comp.extended_desc END 'item_extended_desc'
    ,assembly_line.previous_operation
    ,assembly_line.next_operation  FROM
    assembly_line
    INNER JOIN assembly_hdr ON (assembly_hdr.inv_mast_uid = assembly_line.inv_mast_uid)
    INNER JOIN inv_mast ON (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = assembly_line.inv_mast_uid)
    LEFT JOIN inv_mast AS inv_mast_comp ON (assembly_line.component_inv_mast_uid = inv_mast_comp.inv_mast_uid)
    LEFT JOIN service_labor ON (assembly_line.service_labor_uid = service_labor.service_labor_uid)
    LEFT JOIN inv_mast_assem_info ON (inv_mast_assem_info.inv_mast_uid = assembly_line.component_inv_mast_uid)
    LEFT JOIN operation ON (assembly_line.operation_uid = operation.operation_uid)
    LEFT JOIN item_revision ON item_revision.inv_mast_uid = assembly_line.component_inv_mast_uid
    AND item_revision.item_revision_uid = assembly_line.component_item_revision_uid
    LEFT JOIN ( SELECT assembly_hdr.production_order_processing ,assembly_hdr.inv_mast_uid
    FROM assembly_hdr
    ) AS drv_subassembly_hdr ON drv_subassembly_hdr.inv_mast_uid = assembly_line.component_inv_mast_uid
    AND assembly_line.sub_assembly = 'Y'  WHERE  (assembly_line.inv_mast_uid = :al_InvMastUid) AND (assembly_item_revision_uid = :al_AssemblyItemUid)
